name: AAC - 10 - Revise Article from Doctor Feedback

parameters.sqlQuery:
-- AAC Phase 1G
-- Load the newest unprocessed doctor revision request and its complete source context.
WITH latest_change_request AS (
  SELECT approval_id, article_id, response, responded_at
  FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals`
  WHERE approval_type = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW'
    AND status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
    AND LENGTH(TRIM(response)) > 0
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY responded_at DESC, requested_at DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  a.article_id,
  a.interview_id,
  a.campaign_id,
  a.doctor_id,
  a.practice_id,
  a.current_version,
  COALESCE(c.doctor_review_days, 5) AS doctor_review_days,
  r.approval_id,
  r.response AS revision_instruction,
  r.responded_at,
  v.content AS current_package_json,
  i.transcript,
  i.topic_id,
  d.doctor_name,
  d.credentials,
  p.practice_name,
  p.website_domain,
  p.publisher_config_reference,
  c.campaign_name,
  c.campaign_month,
  t.topic_title,
  t.topic_description,
  t.interview_guidance,
  (
    SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(
      history.version_number,
      history.version_type,
      history.revision_instruction,
      history.created_at
    ) ORDER BY history.version_number))
    FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` history
    WHERE history.article_id = a.article_id
  ) AS revision_history_json
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
JOIN latest_change_request r ON r.article_id = a.article_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` v
  ON v.article_id = a.article_id AND v.version_number = a.current_version
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interviews` i ON i.interview_id = a.interview_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p ON p.practice_id = a.practice_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_topics` t ON t.topic_id = i.topic_id
WHERE a.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
ORDER BY r.responded_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- AAC Phase 1G
-- Issue a fresh one-time link for the newly revised article version.
UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
SET status = 'SUPERSEDED'
WHERE article_id = @article_id AND status IN ('READY', 'OPENED');

CREATE TEMP TABLE new_link AS
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID() AS review_link_id,
  a.article_id,
  a.doctor_id,
  a.current_version,
  CONCAT(REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', ''), REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', '')) AS raw_token,
  a.doctor_review_deadline AS expires_at
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
WHERE a.article_id = @article_id
  AND a.status = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW_PENDING';

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
(review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, secure_token_hash, status, created_at, expires_at)
SELECT review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, TO_HEX(SHA256(raw_token)), 'READY', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), expires_at
FROM new_link;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` T
USING (
  SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS approval_id, article_id, 'DOCTOR_REVIEW' AS approval_type,
    'PENDING' AS status, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS requested_at, expires_at AS deadline
  FROM new_link
) S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.approval_type = S.approval_type AND T.status = 'PENDING'
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET requested_at = S.requested_at, deadline = S.deadline, responded_at = NULL, response = NULL
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (approval_id, article_id, approval_type, status, requested_at, deadline)
  VALUES (S.approval_id, S.article_id, S.approval_type, S.status, S.requested_at, S.deadline);

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', article_id, 'doctor.review_requested', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'n8n', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(review_link_id, current_version AS version_number, expires_at))
FROM new_link;

SELECT
  article_id,
  doctor_id,
  current_version,
  review_link_id,
  expires_at,
  CONCAT('https://apex-content-interviewer.jdold.workers.dev/review/', raw_token) AS review_url,
  'READY' AS link_status
FROM new_link;

parameters.content:
## AAC Phase 1G - Doctor Revision Loop

Manual vertical slice:
change request → source context → dedicated revision prompt → OpenAI Responses API → validation → immutable version insert → fresh one-time review link.

After import:
1. Connect the existing BigQuery credential to all three BigQuery nodes.
2. Connect **OpenAi account** to **Revise Article with OpenAI**.
3. Run manually against a `CHANGES_REQUESTED` article.

The prompt is version-controlled at `prompts/article-revision-master-prompt.md`. Prior versions are never overwritten.
